sources.note: Developer nyabsi demonstrates SuperTuxKart running natively on PlayStation Vita utilizing a custom Vulkan 1.1 hardware driver.

findings: Significant graphics breakthrough: first demonstration of Vulkan 1.1 running directly on PS Vita hardware powering SuperTuxKart. Video proof demonstrates rendering on OLED screen. Custom driver and port remain in active development without a public binary or open repository.
vita_hardware_result: SuperTuxKart gameplay rendering on physical PS Vita through native Vulkan 1.1 driver.
vita_evidence: Direct capture of SuperTuxKart racing with Vulkan 1.1 driver execution on Vita
